notes: phase cycles subtract the entry checkpoint cost (c1 - c0), which may overstate the in-phase checkpoint cost by a few cycles: phases may be a few cy short
load = a 4 B .nc load + the dependent address (LOP3, LEA, LEA.HI.X) + a dependent 16 B .nc load + the consuming shared store; every index and address is computed before entry

compute = the seed FADD + 256 dependent FFMA, fully unrolled (no loop control); compute_cycles_per_ffma per block count. Hypotheses, not established: at 1 block/SM a rise of cycles/FFMA with FFMA_N (64..4096 = 1-64 KB of straight-line code) points at instruction-cache overflow; at 3 blocks/SM issue contention between overlapping warps also grows with FFMA_N; a cold sequential fetch cost per instruction is constant in FFMA_N and cannot be separated from the FFMA latency by the sweep (compare with the instr profile's isolated FFMA latency); Ampere/Hopper L0/L1 i-cache sizes are undocumented
barrier1/2 = the barrier + exactly the calibrated touch chain; tail = third barrier + shared load of (ticket, flag pointer) + writer predicate; flag_store = the predicated flag store alone

scoreboard waits (SASS control bits, NVRTC 12.9): the computed stamp's opening timer read waits on the barrier-1 touch's STS register read (hidden behind >= 64 dependent FFMA); the stamp after the flag store may wait on the STG's operand read if ptxas reuses its register (not in the checked build)
ticket = warp 0 only (the atomic with return); the other 7 warps branch around it
flag write window = [max(flag checkpoint, flag value), exit checkpoint] of the writer warp (no value + tick bound)

exit excludes the writer's system fence (layout 1 included it: ~3.5k cy A100, ~1.8k cy RTX 3060): kernel_span_ns and last_exit_to_sync_return_ns are not comparable with layout 1; kernel_span_incl_writer_fence_ns and last_exit_incl_writer_fence_to_sync_return_ns are; writer_fence_cycles = writer's exit -> fence done (MEMBAR.SC.SYS + ERRBAR, as in layout 1, plus ~10 setup instructions incl. an S2R: a few tens of cycles)
host-axis latencies carry the run's host<->GPU bound (bound_ns) in addition to the block bound
